method: Read all 10 actual frozen V51 JSON source packs covering SC50-0006 (190 KUs) and SC50-0008 (188 KUs), compare candidate targets to contextually related neighboring teaching units; semantic distinctions are editorial assessments, not Master approvals.

subject.original_example_en: The washer reported a spin failure at the end of the cycle.

related_distinct_kus.distinction: This is a washing machine program, not its failure.
This is an action, not a diagnosed error.
Drainage failure is mechanically distinct from spin failure; problems may correlate but cannot be merged semantically.

scenes.editorial_finding: No exact canonical spin-failure duplicate found among all 190 records. Distinct concept exists, but standalone phrase is technical; original example 'washer reported' should not imply every washer uses that error label.

subject.original_example_en: I'll warm up a late dinner for you when you get home.

related_potential_overlaps.example_en: Could you warm up food for the children?
related_potential_overlaps.overlap: Same warm up + food action; dinner is a specific food meal.

related_potential_overlaps.example_en: We need to reheat dinner because everyone got home late.
related_potential_overlaps.overlap: Existing late-return dinner reheating context directly covers likely pedagogical intent of KU01637.

related_potential_overlaps.example_en: I saved you a plate of dinner in the fridge.
related_potential_overlaps.overlap: Distinct action of reserving food, not reheating; must not merge.

scenes.editorial_finding: There is no exact string duplicate, but a near-complete teaching-objective overlap with KU01564 and especially KU01565. Replacing KU01637 target with warm up dinner would still compete with existing KU01565 reheat dinner.
scenes.recommended_master_action: Prefer to retain frozen KU01637 as identity HOLD; ask Master whether to suppress its separate learning objective after verifying stable source, or document a genuinely distinct pragmatic target and new example. Do not auto-replace it with warm up dinner or merge frozen identities.
